title: Ancillary dwellings merit assessment criteria
text: M2.8.1 The size of an ancillary dwelling allows for adequate internal amenity whilst remaining incidental to the primary dwelling. M2.8.2 Ancillary dwellings allow for diversity of housing while minimising adverse impacts on the amenity of: i. adjoining properties; ii. streetscape and local character; and iii. the primary dwelling.
